column3: ...Who are you?\nYou don't feel like\nanyone I've met.{end_wait}
Does that frighten you?{end_wait}
It makes me careful.\nWhat do you want?{end_wait}
A woman named Heart\nwould know that face.\nBut she would be wrong.{end_wait}
Who does she think I am?{end_wait}
Matthew. He will be a\nnuisance to my commanders.{page_break}Heart still bears\nthe scars he left her.{end_wait}
That wasn't me.{end_wait}
I know. He wears\nyour face. Amusing,\nisn't it.{end_wait}
Where did you meet\nsomeone with my face?{end_wait}
In a world much like\nyour own, Isaac.\nBut thirty years older.{end_wait}

I came to study your
Psynergy on its own.
Not your companions'.{page_break}I've watched the others
who sought you out.
Ash Jenna, Sarah, Kegare.{end_wait}

A word at the right
time can change a path.
They chose their own.{page_break}Ash Jenna wants revenge.
Sarah seeks her family.
Kegare wants a place here.{page_break}I'll hold back. I need
to see what your power
can do without help.{end_wait}
...You're\nunderestimating me.{end_wait}
Perhaps.\nDraw your sword.{end_wait}
You still haven't\nanswered me. Who are you?{end_wait}
Still asking, Isaac?{page_break}Your friends are free.\nI didn't release them.{end_wait}
I wanted to see\nhow you'd fight alone.{page_break}I learned more than\nI expected.{end_wait}
And what did\nyou learn?{end_wait}
Your power is one thing.\nWhat they bring out\nin you is another.{page_break}I hadn't counted on that.{end_wait}

Heart answers to me.
That much is true.{page_break}I'll remind her
whose orders she
carries.{end_wait}
Your orders?{end_wait}
Heart can find a weak\npoint between worlds.\nI need her alive.{end_wait}
When the Grave Eclipse\ncomes, remember\nthis day.{end_wait}
Thirty years, Isaac.\nI will see you then.{end_wait}
Isaac! I can't move!\nWhat did you do to us?{end_wait}
My Psynergy won't answer.\nShe's holding it back.{end_wait}
She's been waiting for us.\nIsaac, don't believe this\nwas a chance meeting.{end_wait}
Let them go.\nI'm the one you want.{end_wait}
They're unharmed.\nBut they won't interfere.\nThis is between us, Isaac.{page_break}Show me what you can do.{end_wait}
And thirty years?\nWhat did she mean by that?{end_wait}
Did you send them here?\nWhat does that have to\ndo with me?{end_wait}
You scared the life\nout of me, Isaac.\nAre you all right?{end_wait}
I'm fine.\nAre you three okay?{end_wait}

I'm fine. But she
stopped my Psynergy.
I couldn't reach it.{page_break}I felt her hold weaken.
I still don't know how
she managed it.{end_wait}
So those others...\nHow many more like her\nare out there?{end_wait}
We don't know.\nBut she knew what\neach of them wanted.{end_wait}
Then how long has she\nbeen watching us?{end_wait}
We'll tell the elders.\nIf more of them come\nthrough, we need to know.{end_wait}
